findings.title: Token rotation can still commit before final join-blob validation
findings.expected_behavior: The exact candidate blob is prepared before token authority changes, or every config/app-state/runtime change is compensated before failure returns.
findings.actual_behavior: A 26-character placeholder preflight passes at 32731 bytes, token rotation commits a 64-character generated token, and final encoding fails at 32769 bytes without rollback or blob.
findings.impact: Existing workers can lose valid credentials without receiving a replacement secret, causing coordinator availability and recovery loss.

findings.root_cause: Preflight uses a differently sized surrogate secret and final blob construction occurs outside token-mutation compensation.
findings.invariant: Auth/secret rotation is atomic and compensating, with truthful recovery evidence.
findings.existing_protection: Malformed non-secret fields fail before rotation; running-token update failure has targeted rollback.
findings.protection_gap: Final exact-token encode can fail after mutation and has no transaction context.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Generate the exact candidate token, encode the complete blob before mutation, then commit config/app-state/runtime with full compensation and return the blob only after commit.
findings.required_regression_test: Near-limit and injected-final-encode failures leave config, app state, and running token unchanged; save/runtime failures restore all authority without secret leakage.
findings.required_validation_rung: Join/settings/runtime transaction tests, Local API secret/journal tests, two-process auth recovery, packaged restart, strict packet coverage.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: The failure/commit ordering is reproduced; the normal trigger is a narrow 38-byte window near 32 KiB.

findings.title: Coordinator join-blob creation still bypasses configured role authority
findings.expected_behavior: Coordinator secret creation requires coordinator role or a separately named/documented offline-bootstrap authority.
findings.actual_behavior: Role is echoed only; standalone and worker configurations can invoke the coordinator route, rotate token state, and mint a join blob.
findings.impact: Authenticated local callers bypass configured role authority and can create confusing or invalid cluster credentials/state.
